Characteristics:
Probes AMETEK Petro-Stik 7100 & 7250, AMETEX 7100V & 7250V Flex- Stik
Measuring principle: Magnetostrictive
Stainless steel – Petro-Stik, PVDF – Flex-Stik
Length up to 2.8 m
